name: set_node_property_history_recording
description: Turn node-property history recording on or off -- a single GLOBAL switch for the whole installation (every device/property), not scoped to one device. Persists across IoX restarts; defaults to Off on a fresh install, so historical data from before recording was turned on simply doesn't exist -- get_node_property_history can only return data for periods when this was on. This tool's own result reports the state it just set, so a normal 'turn history on/off' request never needs a separate status check first; call get_full_system_config only if you need to check the CURRENT state before deciding whether to toggle it (its 'Node Property History Enabled' field reports this).

enabled.description: True to turn node-property history recording on, false to turn it off.
